# Distribution setup: the owner's checklist

<!-- Generated by `node platform/distribution/setup.mjs --write` from
     portfolio/distribution/accounts.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

Every channel in [`channels.yaml`](channels.yaml) is built and does a dry run until its switch is set. This page lists the switches, cheapest first. Sign every account up with **accounts@marisstella.app** (the one address every portfolio platform account is registered with: sign-up confirmations, password resets and platform notices); it lands in the agent-managed inbox (`platform/edge/inbox.mjs`) once the Cloudflare email step below is done. Secrets go in Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions; their values never go in the repository.

Agents do everything after the sign-up: the posts, the tokens' use, de-duplication, measuring. The sign-up itself is yours (goals.md, "Hard limits": registering accounts and publishing under the portfolio's name), because sign-up forms ask a person to accept the terms and prove they are a person, and automating past that is on the distribution spec's "never" list.

## 0. No new account: switches on this repository

### GitHub (this repository)

- Switches on: `github-release-digest` (now artifact), `tool-releases` (now artifact), `ghcr-container-images` (now artifact), `desktop-apps` (now artifact)
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_RELEASES`, `DISTRIBUTE_TOOL_RELEASES`, `DISTRIBUTE_GHCR`, `DISTRIBUTE_DESKTOP`

1. No new account: the workflows use their own GITHUB_TOKEN.
2. Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > Variables: set DISTRIBUTE_RELEASES=true (a weekly launches release) and DISTRIBUTE_TOOL_RELEASES=true (version tags for allow-listed tools).
3. Optional: DISTRIBUTE_GHCR=true (container images) and DISTRIBUTE_DESKTOP=true (desktop app builds).

### Mail to accounts@marisstella.app (Cloudflare Email Routing)


1. Do this before any sign-up below, or the confirmation emails bounce (the domain had no MX record on 2026-10-31).
2. Give the deploy token the Email Routing permissions listed at the top of platform/pages/cloudflare/email-routing.mjs, then run the cloudflare-email workflow with apply ticked. support@, hello@ and accounts@ then land in the agent-managed inbox (platform/edge/inbox.mjs); nothing is forwarded and there is no verification link.
3. Set the INBOX_TOKEN secret on the edge Worker (`npx wrangler secret put INBOX_TOKEN` in platform/edge, any long random string) and give agent sessions the same value as an environment variable, so they can read the inbox with `node platform/edge/read-inbox.mjs`.

## 1. Labelled bot accounts (free, API-friendly)

### Bluesky

- Sign up: https://bsky.app with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `bluesky-bot` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `BSKY_HANDLE`, `BSKY_APP_PASSWORD`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_BLUESKY`

1. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app. Say in the bio that the account is automated and posts new free tools and write-ups from the portfolio.
2. Settings > Privacy and security > App passwords: create one for this repository. Never store the account password.
3. Add secrets BSKY_HANDLE and BSKY_APP_PASSWORD, then set DISTRIBUTE_BLUESKY=true. Dry run first: node platform/distribution/bluesky.mjs

### Mastodon (one instance that welcomes labelled bots)

- Sign up: https://joinmastodon.org/servers with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `mastodon-bot` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `MASTODON_TOKEN`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_MASTODON`, `MASTODON_INSTANCE`, `MASTODON_ACCT`

1. Pick an instance whose rules allow bot accounts and self-promotion of free software. Read its rules the day you sign up.
2. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app and tick "This is a bot account" in the profile (the script refuses to post without it).
3. Preferences > Development > New application: scopes write:statuses and read:accounts only. Store the token as MASTODON_TOKEN.
4. Set MASTODON_INSTANCE (https URL), MASTODON_ACCT (the handle, for the hub's metrics) and DISTRIBUTE_MASTODON=true.

## 2. Cross-posting the blog posts, with a canonical link back

### dev.to

- Sign up: https://dev.to/enter with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `devto-crosspost` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `DEVTO_API_KEY`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_DEVTO`, `DEVTO_PUBLISH`

1. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app (email sign-up, not a social login, so the account does not hang off a personal profile).
2. Settings > Extensions > DEV Community API Keys: generate one, store it as DEVTO_API_KEY, set DISTRIBUTE_DEVTO=true.
3. Articles are drafts until DEVTO_PUBLISH=true. Read the first few drafts before you set it.

### Hashnode

- Sign up: https://hashnode.com/onboard with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `hashnode-crosspost` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `HASHNODE_TOKEN`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_HASHNODE`, `HASHNODE_PUBLICATION_ID`, `HASHNODE_PUBLISH`

1. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app and create one publication (blog).
2. Account settings > Developer: generate a personal access token, store it as HASHNODE_TOKEN.
3. Set HASHNODE_PUBLICATION_ID and DISTRIBUTE_HASHNODE=true. Posts are drafts until HASHNODE_PUBLISH=true.

## 3. Package registries

### npm registry

- Sign up: https://www.npmjs.com/signup with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `npm-cli-packages` (now artifact), `mcp-server` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `NPM_TOKEN`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_NPM`, `NPM_SCOPE`, `DISTRIBUTE_MCP`

1. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app and turn on two-factor authentication (npm asks for it to publish).
2. Create an organisation for the scope (NPM_SCOPE); two names are taken by other projects without one (portfolio/distribution/README.md).
3. Access Tokens > Generate: a granular token limited to that scope, with an expiry. Store it as NPM_TOKEN; set NPM_SCOPE, DISTRIBUTE_NPM=true and, for the MCP server, DISTRIBUTE_MCP=true.

### PyPI

- Sign up: https://pypi.org/account/register/ with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `pypi-python-clis` (now artifact), `pypi-pyproject-packages` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `PYPI_TOKEN`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_PYPI`

1. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app and turn on two-factor authentication (PyPI requires it).
2. Account settings > API tokens: create one. Store it as PYPI_TOKEN and set DISTRIBUTE_PYPI=true.

### Homebrew tap (a second GitHub repository)

- Switches on: `homebrew-tap` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_HOMEBREW`, `HOMEBREW_TAP_REPO`

1. Create an empty public repository named homebrew-<something> under your account.
2. Create a fine-grained token with Contents: write on that repository only. Store it as HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN.
3. Set HOMEBREW_TAP_REPO (owner/name) and DISTRIBUTE_HOMEBREW=true. Needs the npm channel live first (formulae install the npm packages).

## 4. Accounts that need a decision first

### Meta: Threads, a Facebook Page, Instagram

- Sign up: https://developers.facebook.com/apps
- Switches on: `hub-threads` (now artifact), `hub-facebook` (now artifact), `hub-instagram` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `THREADS_TOKEN`, `FACEBOOK_PAGE_TOKEN`, `INSTAGRAM_TOKEN`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_THREADS`, `THREADS_USER_ID`, `DISTRIBUTE_FACEBOOK`, `FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID`, `DISTRIBUTE_INSTAGRAM`, `INSTAGRAM_USER_ID`, `INSTAGRAM_IMAGE_BASE`

1. These hang off a personal Meta login: a Page is administered from a personal profile, and Threads and Instagram professional accounts link to it. So the sign-up address is yours, not accounts@. Contact email on the Page can still be hello@marisstella.app.
2. Create the Page and an Instagram professional account, then a Meta developer app with the permissions listed in node platform/distribution/hub.mjs platforms.
3. Store THREADS_TOKEN, FACEBOOK_PAGE_TOKEN, INSTAGRAM_TOKEN; set the IDs, INSTAGRAM_IMAGE_BASE and each DISTRIBUTE_* you want on. Each platform is independent.

### Buttondown (opt-in email list)

- Sign up: https://buttondown.com/register with accounts@marisstella.app
- Switches on: `hub-email` (now artifact)
- Secrets: `BUTTONDOWN_API_KEY`
- Variables: `DISTRIBUTE_EMAIL`, `EMAIL_SEND`

1. Decide the postal address every email must show (CAN-SPAM). That is the only decision here that is not a click.
2. Sign up with accounts@marisstella.app, set the reply-to to hello@marisstella.app, keep double opt-in on.
3. Store BUTTONDOWN_API_KEY and set DISTRIBUTE_EMAIL=true. Emails are drafts until EMAIL_SEND=true.

After each one, move its row in `channels.yaml` to `live`, and to `measured` once `node platform/distribution/attribution.mjs` shows arrivals from it.
